input.quote: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: we own Customer Data and Deliverables (with a Vendor assignment), Vendor retains only its pre-existing Vendor Technology subject to the perpetual licence in 13.2, no joint ownership is created, and feedback use is limited and non-attributed.

input.quote: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes
input.rationale: Preferred position met: the grant expressly covers Affiliates and contractors, paid-up/embedded licences are perpetual and irrevocable (13.2), licence rights transfer to Affiliates and successors (13.3), and suspension is limited to material uncured breach after notice and cure.

input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable via an independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to our systems or unrelated data.
